messages:
maria_release: rolling the 00:30 changewindow deploy for usergateway v4.7.0-canary (start canary 15%). doing an obs sweep before we push more.
deploy-bot: Canary started service=usergateway version=v4.7.0-canary env=prod region=us-west-1 canary=15% (id=cb-1768190000) :rocket:
maria_release: quick checklist: p95, request error-rate (5xx), rate-limiter drops (429), and kvcache tail. dashboard -> /dashboards/deploy/usergateway.
anthony_sre: pulling p95 now. baseline p95 120ms, canary p95 130ms. small drift.
paul_release: alerting: I'm seeing a +22 delta on 5xx for route=/tokens in last 5m.
alice_obs: what's the query you used? want to correlate with alert rules.
paul_release: `sum(increase(http_requests_total{job=\"usergateway\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (route)` \u2014 /tokens: +22, other routes +2..+4.
anthony_sre: that crosses our pause threshold (we keep pause at delta>20).
maria_release: can we isolate to hosts or azs? any host spikes?
alice_obs: host breakdown shows errors from host-1a-07 and host-1a-09, both in az1. traces show a stack of RateLimitExceeded in token-validator with a recent dependency version bump.
paul_release: rolling a hotfix would take ~40m. we shouldn't risk full rollback if a targeted mitigation is possible.
anthony_sre: option: partial pin /tokens route to previous version v4.6.9 for canary traffic. Or reroute embed-heavy clients to fallback. Partial pin seems fastest.
maria_release: agree. apply partial route pin for /tokens only in canary scope. include note in release notes.
deploy-bot: Executing route pin: `tools/routerctl pin /tokens --from v4.7.0-canary --to v4.6.9 --percent 100 --scope=canary`
deploy-bot: Route pin applied (/tokens -> v4.6.9) for canary id=cb-1768190000 :white_check_mark:
paul_release: 5xx back to baseline within 90s after pin. p95 stable. nice one.
alice_obs: saving snapshots: /runs/1768190000/obs_snapshot.json and traces to /runs/1768190000/traces.tgz.
maria_release: decision: continue rollout to 45% now, keep /tokens pinned until post-deploy follow-up ticket to revert when fix merged. record in release notes: "Partial pin of /tokens -> v4.6.9 during canary due to rate-limit exceptions; no full rollback."
anthony_sre: filing post-deploy ticket RGW-1294 to revert pin and fix validator dependency handling.
deploy-bot: Canary percent increased to 45% (id=cb-1768190000) by paul_release at 1768190060.
maria_release: monitoring for 15m at this threshold; if no new 5xx or p95 delta >25% we'll progress to 90%.
alice_obs: set an ad-hoc alert to watch /tokens 5xx delta and kvcache tail on az1 hosts. pinging paging policy if it breaches.
maria_release: thanks all. keeping thread open for late regressions.
